Questions

Where are the curviest roads in Arkansas?

By count of mapped bends, the most are in Garland County, Pulaski County, Benton County. Each county page lists its curviest roads and sharpest bends.

What counts as a curve?

A bend tighter than 600 ft in radius. Loops, ramps, and corners under 50 ft are left out.

Does the map show gravel roads?

Yes. Paved and unpaved roads are shown in different colors, and you can turn either off.

Is the map free?

Yes. It works in any browser, with no account.
